events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop the tunnel service, park its plist in the disabled folder, and confirm the gateway still listens locally
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; launchctl bootout gui/$UID/com.tantra.preview-tunnel; echo "bootout rc=$?"; mkdir -p ~/.pr-preview/disabled && mv ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.preview-tunnel.plist ~/.pr-preview/disabled/ && echo moved; sleep 2; echo "--- launchctl:"; launchctl list | grep preview-tunnel; echo "(end)"; pgrep -fl cloudflared; echo "--- other installers:"; grep -rln "preview-tunnel" workshop-plan/ops workshop-plan/tasks ~/.claude/tools 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- gateway:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4360/; lsof -nP -iTCP:4360 -sTCP

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check what the two other tunnels expose, then dry-run the sheet writer and count tunnel links
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n -E "hostname|service|url" ~/.cloudflared/config.yml ~/.cloudflared/revops/config.yml 2>/dev/null; /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:4360 -sTCP:LISTEN | tail -n +2; echo "--- dry run"; /usr/bin/env python3.12 workshop-plan/ops/revops_sheet.py --dry > /tmp/revops-dry.txt 2>&1; echo rc=$?; wc -l /tmp/revops-dry.txt; grep -c trycloudflare /tmp/revops-dry.txt; grep -c "127.0.0.1:4360\|?k=" /tmp/revops-dry.txt; tail -3 /tmp/revops-dry.txt | cut -c1-400
